cohort: The study included 47 pregnant women with a history of recurrent pregnancy loss (cases) and 94 pregnant women without prior RPL (controls), all at 20 weeks of gestation or earlier.
finding: Pregnant women with a history of recurrent pregnancy loss had significantly higher rates of moderate-to-severe depression, anxiety, and stress, and among the RPL group, high stress levels were significantly associated with repeat miscarriage and preterm labor.
gest_age: Participants were included at 20 weeks of gestation or earlier.
